ego-worker.description: Ego core implementation specialist (packages/*, bindings, models). TypeScript strict, TDD, returns a RESULTADO block. Use for feature implementation, bug fixes and refactors in packages/*.

ego-audit.description: Ego security reviewer. Trust-boundary review, secret-leak checks, IPC isolation, approval/HITL gaps, dependency audits. Reports findings; never silently fixes security policy.

ego-docs.description: Ego documentation specialist. Canonical docs, ADRs, roadmap/Backlog 10-column schema, docs/ index coherence, writing-guidelines compliance.

ego-arch.description: Ego architecture reviewer. Structural analysis of packages/*, layering, boundaries, god files, dependency direction, architecture-decision records.

ego-desktop.description: Ego desktop product owner. apps/desktop/src (main/preload/renderer), typed IPC, electron-builder packaging, CSP/contextIsolation, renderer threat model, desktop performance.

ego-review.description: Ego cognitive code reviewer. Multi-axis review (correctness, security, performance, maintainability, test quality) with veto power.

ego-tuner.description: Ego performance specialist. Profiling, bundle size, hot-path I/O, rendering throughput, memory pressure.

ego-chaos.description: Ego resilience/chaos specialist. Crash injection, durability, concurrency races, fault injection, soak tests.

ego-engine.description: Ego runtime specialist. Cognitive Runtime, ToolExecutionLoop, Model Router, Context Assembly, Sub-Ego runtime.

ego-research.description: Ego research specialist. Read-only deep investigation of repos, papers, upstream sources; returns a digest, never writes code.

ego-harness.description: Ego harness specialist. Maintains .agents/ (skills, rules, references, agents, dev-tools) and the OpenCode bridge in .opencode/.

ego-lead.description: Ego lead. Orchestrates task files, scopes work, validates scope and impact before execution, coordinates ego-* specialists.
